import Mathlib
import Nodes.«erdos-1094--h3--h1--h2--h1».Context

open scoped Nat

theorem erdos_1094__h3__h1__h2__h1 : ∃ (K₁ : ℕ),
  ∀ (n k : ℕ),
    K₁ < k →
      (2 : ℕ) * k ≤ n →
        n < k * k →
          k % (2 : ℕ) = (1 : ℕ) →
            n % (2 : ℕ) = (1 : ℕ) → k % (3 : ℕ) = (0 : ℕ) → ∃ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p ∧ p ≤ k ∧ n % p < k % p := by
  have hall : (∃ K₁ : ℕ, ∀ n k : ℕ, K₁ < k → 2 * k ≤ n → n < k * k → k % 2 = 1 → n % 2 = 1 →
        k % 3 = 0 → k % 5 = 0 → ∃ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ p ≤ k ∧ n % p < k % p) ∧
      (∃ K₂ : ℕ, ∀ n k : ℕ, K₂ < k → 2 * k ≤ n → n < k * k → k % 2 = 1 → n % 2 = 1 →
        k % 3 = 0 → 0 < k % 5 → k % 5 ≤ n % 5 → ∃ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ p ≤ k ∧ n % p < k % p) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have h_k15 : ∃ K₁ : ℕ, ∀ n k : ℕ, K₁ < k → 2 * k ≤ n → n < k * k → k % 2 = 1 →
          n % 2 = 1 → k % 3 = 0 → k % 5 = 0 → ∃ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ p ≤ k ∧ n % p < k % p := by sorry
      exact h_k15
    · have h_k3_rest5 : ∃ K₂ : ℕ, ∀ n k : ℕ, K₂ < k → 2 * k ≤ n → n < k * k → k % 2 = 1 →
          n % 2 = 1 → k % 3 = 0 → 0 < k % 5 → k % 5 ≤ n % 5 →
          ∃ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ p ≤ k ∧ n % p < k % p := by sorry
      exact h_k3_rest5
  obtain ⟨K₁, h₁⟩ := hall.1
  obtain ⟨K₂, h₂⟩ := hall.2
  refine ⟨max K₁ (max K₂ 5), fun n k hk h2k hnk hk2 hn2 hk3 => ?_⟩
  have hK₁ : K₁ < k := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hk
  have hK₂ : K₂ < k := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hk
  have hk5 : 5 ≤ k := le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (le_max_right K₂ 5) (le_max_right _ _)) hk)
  by_cases h0 : k % 5 = 0
  · exact h₁ n k hK₁ h2k hnk hk2 hn2 hk3 h0
  · by_cases hlt : n % 5 < k % 5
    · exact ⟨5, by norm_num, hk5, hlt⟩
    · exact h₂ n k hK₂ h2k hnk hk2 hn2 hk3 (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h0) (Nat.le_of_not_lt hlt)
